configuration_policy.commercial: Each exact frozen program view fixes reference semantics. One named Medium Office sampling configuration must be fully bound in the pre-implementation sampling audit before the kernel; no unspecified regional/stock selectors are permitted.
configuration_policy.residential: Each exact frozen profile metadata object fixes household, presence, location, equipment and controls; its stored seed is only a reference seed and is replaced by the caller master/native derived seed. No additional household/weather/vintage configurations are advertised in M1.
variable_inputs: ordered repeated instances drawn from cases

coverage_policy.complete_when: Each case has complete source/numerical, annual-budget, binding, mixture and standalone evidence and every pre-implementation gate passes.
coverage_policy.denominator: All cases below and every included active/default/fixed/control slot resolved for those cases; no supported-only denominator.
coverage_policy.outside_scope: Reported separately; does not block M1 and does not count toward its completeness.

interpretation: Authoritative target set for M1, not a claim of implemented support. Missing evidence blocks shipment; changing the set requires a versioned scope revision. No implicit Cartesian products.
